title: Comparing the Quality of Primary Care Electronic Health Record Data in Australia and Canada: Case Study in Osteoarthritis
details: S Thuraisingam, DH Marasinghe, K Barrick… - Journal of Medical Internet …, 2025
abstract: Background General practice electronic health records (EHRs) contain a wealth of patient information. However, these data are collected for clinical purposes. Hence, questions remain around the suitability of using these data for other purposes …
